Trump-Endorsed Jimmy Patronis Pledges to Help Create Committee to Investigate the J6 Committee

[FT. WALTON BEACH / 1-05-25] – Today, Florida Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Jimmy Patronis pledged to work with Congressional leadership on the creation of a committee to investigate Liz Cheney, Adam Kinzinger and the January 6 Committee. Congressional leadership has expressed their interest in investigating the committee. Patronis is the only candidate who is backed by President Donald Trump for the Florida Congressional District 1 special election.        

CFO Jimmy Patronis said, “The January 6 Committee was a taxpayer, subsidized monstrosity to go after President Trump, MAGA, and other Republicans. It was a giant infomercial for the Left to give legacy media something to cover. It wasn’t objective, it wasn’t bipartisan, and it was led by Anti-Trumpers Liz Cheney and Adam Kinzinger who were both ran out of Congress. Representative Jim Jordan did amazing work with the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government – and seeing as Liz Cheney was having ex-parte communications, we need to see what laws were violated and hold those accountable. Moreover, as this was a colossal waste of money, we need to take steps to ensure Congress never abuses taxpayer money in this manner ever again.”  

In addition to being endorsed by President Trump, other GOP leaders, including Speaker Mike Johnson, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise and House Majority Whip Tom Emmer have endorsed Jimmy Patronis in the CD-1 race. The Special Primary Election Day is scheduled for January 28, 2025 and the Special General Election is slated for April 1, 2025. I am incredibly honored to announce that four of Ohio’s conservative leaders in the U.S. House of Representatives—Jim Jordan (OH-4), Michael Rulli (OH-6), Troy Balderson (OH-12), and Mike Carey (OH-15)—have officially endorsed my campaign to keep fighting for Southern Ohio!

These leaders are on the front lines every day with me in Washington, and they know that I am ready to keep standing shoulder-to-shoulder with them to protect our jobs, secure our borders, and defend our way of life.

Read their statements below:

“Dave Taylor is a rock-solid conservative and a fearless fighter who understands that the America First agenda starts with protecting our jobs and the way of life in Southern Ohio. As a former prosecutor and successful businessman, he delivers real accountability. He’ll bring common sense to Washington, secure the border, and keep the government off the backs of hard-working Americans."
— Congressman Jim Jordan (OH-4) @Jim_Jordan 

"Dave Taylor is a common-sense leader who knows exactly what it takes to get Ohio’s economy moving again. As a fellow businessman, I’ve seen firsthand how Dave fights to cut red tape and protect our local industries from government overreach. He’s a tireless advocate for Southern Ohio, and I’m proud to stand with him in Congress to deliver real results for our families and our future."
— Congressman Michael Rulli (OH-6)@michaelrulli 

“I’m proud to support my friend, Dave Taylor, a proven conservative who’s fighting hard for the issues that matter most for his district, like infrastructure and job opportunities for our rural communities. Dave isn’t chasing the spotlight—he’s focused on getting results for the families of southern Ohio. He has my full support, and I look forward to continuing our work together.”
— Congressman Troy Balderson (OH-12)@Troy_Balderson 

"Dave Taylor is a rock-solid conservative who stands up for our values without apology. Whether he is advocating for our farmers or fighting for our energy jobs, Dave is the champion Southern Ohio deserves. He has proven himself to be a fearless fighter for the America First movement, and I am proud to stand with him in his re-election campaign."
— Congressman Mike Carey (OH-15)@RepMikeCarey 

Together, we are building a unified front to put Ohio first. Let’s keep this momentum going! 🇺🇸

#OH02 #Ohio #AmericaFirst #TeamTaylor #CommonSense
